comment: A layer name the row cuts short reads whole on hover. The default arrangement at 1920 by 1080, so the Layers docker is at its default width. A Brightness/Contrast adjustment layer is added the way the scenario adds it, which names the layer Brightness Contrast, and the row cuts it to 'Brightness ...' (shot 1, the pointer away). The pointer then rests on the row's picture, the first Thumbnail, which is the top row's and takes no press of its own, so the tooltip is the row's and its tooltip is the whole name (shot 2). A note is written on the active layer, which is the adjustment layer, and the pointer rests on the row again, which reads the name over the note (shot 3).

layer.comment: Lifted by hand, so the sky does not sink
